title: Utility Line Protection Plans Rate Card: Slab Opening Rates by Line and Home Type
content:
# Rate Card: Slab Opening Rates

Allowance rate card for the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans, slab access on interior lines.

## Rule

A drain line lies deeper beneath the slab than a supply line, and the slab of an attached home is shared with the neighbouring unit and is cut only after the party-wall side has been scanned. Slab opening rate: a slab access payment on an interior drain line takes the drain slab opening rate; a slab access payment on an interior supply line of a property recorded on the plan as a townhome or a duplex takes the attached-home slab opening rate; every other slab access payment takes a slab opening rate of one. The slab opening rate multiplies the plan's slab access allowance in the slab access figure.

## Rates

| Line on the service request | Property type recorded on the plan | Slab opening rate |
|---|---|---|
| interior drain line | any | 1.4 (drain slab opening rate) |
| interior supply line | townhome or duplex | 1.2 (attached-home slab opening rate) |
| interior supply line | single-family home, condominium or any other type | 1 |

The property type is the one recorded on the plan.

## Hypothetical examples (an allowance of $500.00 assumed)

- Interior drain line in a single-family home: $500.00 multiplied by 1.4 is $700.00.
- Interior supply line in a duplex: $500.00 multiplied by 1.2 is $600.00.
- Interior supply line in a single-family home: $500.00 multiplied by 1 is $500.00.
